# Feature: V6 Überformel Play UI

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-03 — issue #348 -->

## Intent
Play-UI for Überformel when Fetzladung is full (3) and a legal upright TEK sits on the board: visible activate path, confirm, preview with fixed **+2 Primär**, resolve via existing engine plan/execute. Generic overlay copy — no character-specific ultimates.

## Preconditions
- Match with `v6Formula` / `meta.v6FormulaEnabled`
- Engine already plans `overformula` at max Fetz + TEK (`planFormulaActivation`)
- Slice-1 overformula recipes bake `overformulaPrimaryBonus: 2` for damage/heal/shield

## Happy Path
- [ ] At Fetz=3 + legal TEK: activate button reads „Überformel aktivieren“ (not character Ulti)
- [ ] Click opens confirm modal with generic German copy + preview (+2 Primär, Fetz → 0)
- [ ] Confirm dispatches `FORMULA_ACTIVATE`; engine resolves Überformel and clears Fetz
- [ ] Inline activation preview (BuildPhaseBar) uses overformula plan when eligible — shows +2 Primär
- [ ] Spielregeln V6 mention Überformel (current TEK, +2 Primär default)
- [ ] German UI; Styleguide Modal/Button; `npm run checks` green

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Fetz &lt; 3 → normal „Formel aktivieren“, no Überformel confirm
- [ ] TEK incomplete → no Überformel path (existing FORMULA_ACTIVATE legality)
- [ ] Cancel confirm → no dispatch
- [ ] V5 / non-V6 → unchanged Großformel / Ulti path

## Out of scope
- Player choice +2 Primär vs +1 Intensität
- Character-specific Überformel names/animations
- Default-Flip / Play-Default cutover
- Expanding locked Slice-1 105 catalog
- Bot Überformel heuristics (#351)

## Security Coverage
- F-03: UI only opens confirm when engine would plan overformula; resolve via `FORMULA_ACTIVATE`
- P-04: local-only match state

## Regression
- [ ] TEK at Fetz&lt;3 still activates as TEK (+1 Fetz)
- [ ] Echo/Delay / Konstrukt UI unchanged
- [ ] V5 Großformel path unaffected

## Assumptions (locked defaults)
1. Focus Play-UI (button / confirm / preview)
2. Fixed default **+2 Primär** (no choice UI yet)
3. Generic overlay text — no character ultimates look
